lines.text: Award Winner Returns to Alma Mater
Students were stunned when actor Daniel Rivero, famous
for his award-winning role in Horizon's Edge, visited
Rivero, a recent graduate of the Theater Arts program,
returned to lead an impromptu drama workshop. Students
crowded the theater hall, snapping selfies with the star and
asking about his journey from Ashburn to Hollywood.
"I skipped lunch just to hear him," said sophomore
Lily Chen. Rivero shared stories from his early auditions,
including moments of rejection that taught him resilience.
"Embrace failure—it's the doorway to invention," he told
students. He also praised Ashburn's faculty for fostering his
love of storytelling. "It feels like I never left," he added.

media flooded by photos from the workshop. For many
